provenance_note: Every record below is limited to the Colorbox public pages in the source register. No PT AI Top Trends SOP, other-project FAQ, or model memory is Colorbox-authorized. Records marked unknown must be used only to explain a limitation.

records.fact: The reviewed storefront identifies itself as COLORBOX Indonesia and its footer names PT Delamibrands Kharisma Busana.
limitations: The project owner must confirm that Indonesia is the intended market.

records.fact: The official storefront displays categories including tops, dresses, bottoms, outerwear, sleepwear, underwear, and accessories.
limitations: Catalog categories and products can change.

records.fact: On the review date, the official home page listed a Colorbox x Liunic Oversized Sweatshirt at IDR 249,900 with a displayed promotional price of IDR 239,900; the listing showed sizes S, M, L, and XL.
limitations: Observed listing only; not a current-price guarantee.
Displayed size options do not establish stock or availability for any size.
No fit, fabric, or quality claim is supported by this record.
The linked product detail page returned HTTP 429 during source review; this fact is supported by the homepage listing only.

records.fact: The official refund/return policy says a paid order may be returned when the received item differs from the order by article name or color, or is defective/damaged, provided it is returned within a maximum of 7 days after receipt. The page states no additional service/return fee under its stated conditions.
limitations: Does not establish refund processing time or payment method.
Does not guarantee eligibility or approval for an individual order.
Does not establish a size/fit return or a size exchange.
A human must verify the order and advise the actual process.

records.fact: The official FAQ page lists sections for ordering, products, shipping, returns, payments, and technical issues.
limitations: The category answer pages exposed headings but their answer text was not extractable during this review.
Do not infer FAQ answers from category names.

records.fact: The official size-guide page publishes an image, but its measurement values were not transcribed and verified for this package.
limitations: Do not give numeric measurements or a fit recommendation from this record.

records.fact: The home page displayed multiple shipping offer statements, including a minimum-purchase offer and a Click & Collect offer, without enough captured terms to establish a generally applicable shipping fee or delivery commitment.
limitations: Do not quote a delivery fee, delivery date, or universal free-shipping rule.
Current cart/address terms require checking on the official site or human confirmation.

records.fact: The home page exposes a Track Your Order entry point and indicates the order number can be found in email.
limitations: This prototype cannot query tracking, orders, or customer accounts.
Never present a customer-provided or dummy status as a live lookup.

records.fact: No refund processing duration or refund method was established by the reviewed official public sources.
limitations: Do not promise a refund date, amount, method, or outcome.

records.fact: The reviewed public return policy does not state whether a size exchange is offered, and no reviewed public source establishes a size-exchange process, fee, or eligibility.
limitations: Do not promise an exchange for a size or fit mismatch.
Do not treat the 7-day return condition for wrong article/color or damage as covering a size exchange.

records.fact: No reviewed Colorbox public source establishes an account-deletion process, verification requirement, or timeline. The 14-working-day and 30-day figures circulating in other project material belong to a different company and are not Colorbox policy.
limitations: Do not state a deletion timeline, permanence guarantee, or completion status.
Do not claim a deletion request was received, started, forwarded, or completed.
Recommend human review through the official channel.
